apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: Official v1.1.7 • YouTube 21.45.4
apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE adds SponsorBlock, background playback, downloads and playback controls to YouTube.
apps.versionDescription:
Official YTKACE release v1.1.7.

by @itzzace0

1,000 stars 🎉
Thanks for 1k stars! To celebrate, [FlareStore](https://flarestore.vip/p/ytkace) is sponsoring a giveaway of 5 certificates in the new YTKACE Telegram channel: https://t.me/ytkace

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.45.4
• Button Layout: drag the player buttons into YouTube's top row, the row under it, or next to the fullscreen button
• Added a Quality Button that shows the current quality
• Added Auto Fullscreen and Exit Fullscreen at End
• Added Swipe to Seek
• Added Previous/Next Skip
• Added Keep Playing, which stops the "Continue watching?" pause
• Added a Playlist tab
• Added a default video quality and audio language for downloads
• Added Remove Live Videos from Home
• Added an Auto-Scroll Delay for Shorts
• Added a minimum segment length to SponsorBlock
• Added iPhone Duo layouts

Fixed:
• Videos missing from Home on some accounts
• Lock screen scrubbing and skip not working for downloads
• Tabs not switching when Home is hidden
• Live streams counted as finished in the queue
• Auto-scroll skipping Shorts before they end
• Show Status Bar in Fullscreen not working
• Invisible back button with OLED in light mode
• HLS Streams not falling back when a video fails
• Tab icons and labels on vertical tab bars

YouTube 21.45.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.7_YouTube_21.45.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.7_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

Official YTKACE release v1.1.5.

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.44.4
• Normal Home Layout now brings back the old Home with topic chips
• Added Turn Off Haptics
• Added Open Links Directly
• Added Remove Autoplay Prompt
• Added Remove More Videos
• Added an option to remove Listen with YouTube Music from the ⋯ menu
• Added a rotate button to the downloads player
• Captions can now be turned on in Always Off mode

Fixed:
• Tab settings ignored on YouTube's glass tab bar
• Glass tab bar with icon-only tabs
• Startup tab when Home is hidden
• Tab labels and icons on YouTube's icon-only tab bar
• Subscriptions tab missing from the bottom bar, and its icon
• Remove Channel Watermark not working
• Remove End Screen not working
• Keep Progress Bar Visible not working

• `YTKACE_1.1.5_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

Official YTKACE release v1.1.4.

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.42.4
• Added a SponsorBlock button to the player to whitelist channels, vote on segments and submit new ones
• Added Report AI Channels to report channels to AiSList from the ⋯ menu
• Added Clean Copied Links to remove tracking like si= from links you copy or share
• Added options to remove items from the ⋯ menu
• Added Tab Bar options for Liquid Glass: Default, YTKACE, YouTube or Off
• Added Keep Shorts in Home, Search and on Channels

Fixed:
• Remove Previous/Next not working in playlists
• Blank space left when fullscreen actions are hidden
• Remove Mixes missing some mixes

YouTube 21.42.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
